headline: Brazil Wind Blade Maker Aeris Seeks Court Approval for Debt Plan
summary: Aeris, a Brazilian wind-blade maker, asked a São Paulo court to back a debt restructuring plan covering $279 million, with 42% of creditors already on board.
why: Debt restructuring processes directly impact a company's solvency, equity value, and recovery prospects for bondholders and creditors.

impacts.name: Aeris
impacts.why: Seeking court-backed debt restructuring indicates acute financial distress for the manufacturer.
